summary: Booking flow tested end-to-end (public /book + admin bookings + PATCH status). Backend: 8/8 pytest passed (POST /api/bookings public, GET /api/bookings admin-gated 401/403, PATCH /api/bookings/{id} valid+invalid+404, admin sees the newly created booking with all fields and status='new'). Frontend: /book form renders with all 10 fields (name/phone/email/city/expedition/preferred_dates/motorcycle/experience(select)/riders(select)/message); empty-submit and invalid-email show inline data-testid='booking-error'; happy path submits and shows data-testid='booking-success' with personalised thank-you. Admin (injected Mongo session for 7huesexpeditions@gmail.com) -> Bookings tab renders bookings-count, all 9 rows with correct name/email/phone/expedition/date; our just-submitted booking 'E2E Rider 351b9563 / e2e_351b9563@example.com' appears at the top and matches the public submission (end-to-end linkage confirmed). Status dropdown change new->contacted fires PATCH /api/bookings/{id} 200, count decreases 8 new -> 7 new, and after page reload the persisted status remains 'contacted'.
critical_code_review_comments: Bookings() component's load() swallows errors silently via .catch(() => {}). If /api/bookings ever returns 401/500, the UI just shows 'No enquiries yet.' with no indication. Consider surfacing a small inline error state so admins know the fetch failed vs. genuinely empty.
changeStatus() does optimistic update then falls back to load() on failure but doesn't surface the failure to the admin. A subtle toast/inline note would help.
Book.js validates email with a simple regex but leaves phone unvalidated. Not a bug, but a minimal length / digit check would prevent obvious junk submissions.

Booking Pydantic model accepts empty strings for name/phone/email (they're str, not constrained). Since /book UI already enforces required, this is fine, but a public API caller could POST empty strings and still get 200. Consider min_length=1 on required fields.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 5 scenarios: render, validation-empty, validation-email, happy-path, admin-list, admin-status-persist)

test_credentials: Admin session injected into Mongo db 'sevenhues' for 7huesexpeditions@gmail.com (allowlisted). session_token used via cookie + Authorization Bearer. Test session cleaned up after run.
seed_data_creation: Two bookings created via public POST /api/bookings during this run: TEST Rider {uuid} (from pytest) and 'E2E Rider 351b9563' / e2e_351b9563@example.com (from Playwright /book form; status now 'contacted'). Both remain in DB and are visible in admin.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Booking flow is fully working (public form -> DB -> admin list -> PATCH status persist). If retesting: inject Mongo session for 7huesexpeditions@gmail.com and load /admin, click data-testid='admin-tab-bookings'. Note: after navigating to /admin, allow ~1s for auth/me + content hydration before clicking the Bookings tab, otherwise Bookings() mounts and fetches before cookies are effective and shows a stale '0 enquiries' - not a bug, just a fast-click race in headless tests. Admin API traffic observed: GET /api/auth/me, GET /api/content, GET /api/bookings, PATCH /api/bookings/{id}.
